[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd jobs

# The linter and the race detector accept a child that does not look at
# its context: no memory is raced, and the group joins in the end.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./ignores
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names the statement where the child waits and the
# statement that started it, and the finding makes the exit status 1.
! logos conc run -stall 200ms ./ignores
stdout '^jobs done: first job failed$'
stderr '^.*ignores[/\\]main\.lgo:15: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] a group child did not return within 200ms after its group was cancelled'
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:15: the child is here now, in the state: sleep$'
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:22: the group started this child here$'
stderr '^\tfix: '
stderr -count=1 'group_child_stalled'

! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./ignores
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\]'

# A child that another child started is watched in the same way.
! logos conc run -stall 200ms ./nested
stdout '^jobs done: first job failed$'
stderr '^.*nested[/\\]main\.lgo:15: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:23: the group started this child here$'
stderr -count=1 'group_child_stalled'

# A group whose parent context ends is watched in the same way.
! logos conc run -stall 200ms ./outer
stdout '^jobs done: <nil>$'
stderr '^.*outer[/\\]main\.lgo:10: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:18: the group started this child here$'
stderr -count=1 'group_child_stalled'

# The child returns before the default duration of 5s ends.
logos conc run ./ignores
stdout '^jobs done: first job failed$'
! stderr .

# A child that returns at the cancellation gives no finding.
logos conc run -stall 200ms ./returns
stdout '^jobs done: first job failed$'
! stderr .
logos conc test -stall 200ms -count=1 ./returns
! stderr 'conc::'

! logos conc run -stall soon ./returns
stderr '^logos conc run: -stall "soon" is not a positive duration$'
! stdout .
! logos conc test -stall -1s ./returns
stderr '^logos conc test: -stall "-1s" is not a positive duration$'

-- jobs/go.mod --
module example.com/jobs

go 1.27
-- jobs/ignores/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow() error {
	time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow()
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- jobs/ignores/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- jobs/returns/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	select {
	case <-time.After(1500 * time.Millisecond):
	case <-ctx.Done():
	}
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- jobs/returns/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- jobs/outer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func slow() error {
	time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 100*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	go group (ctx) {
		go slow()
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- jobs/nested/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow() error {
	time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go {
			go slow()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
